दिक्कर (रः-री-रं)
a. Young, juvenile.
f. (री) A young woman.

दिक्-पति (तिः) 2.
m. Lord of a cer-
tain part of the universe.

दिक्शूल (लं) 1.
n. Inauspicious pla-
netary conjunction, as of the
Sun
and
Venus in the west.

दीक्ष् (ङ) दीक्षति 1.
a. To be shav-
ed; to sacrifice; to initiate.

दीक्षणीयेष्टि (ष्टिः) 2.
f. A particular
or preliminary sacrifice.

दीक्षा (क्षा) 1.
f. A sacrificing; ce-
remony, worship;
Durgā.

दीक्षा_न्त (न्तः) 1.
m. A supplementary
sacrifice to atone for any defects
that may have occurred in the
principal one.

दीक्षित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Initiated; done.
1.
m. Assemblage of priests for
any sacrifice; pupil of an ascetic.
